evals.prompt: create a skill that checks our changelog entries follow keep-a-changelog format
evals.expected_output: Routes exact format checks (headings, version/date pattern, allowed section names) to a .mjs script and wording judgment to the model; resolves the destination (recommends --target skills in a skills catalog repo, otherwise asks local vs global); scaffolds with scaffold.mjs; writes SKILL.md invoking the script via ${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}; runs validate.mjs with no FAIL; tests on a sample changelog and records the prompt in evals/evals.json.

evals.prompt: improve skills/run-fallow, it looks copied from another project
evals.expected_output: Uses Improve mode and does not scaffold; reads every bundled file and runs validate.mjs first; removes project-specific assumptions (framework entry points, existing config, one repo's thresholds) and replaces them with run-time detection; re-runs validate.mjs; tests the skill on a real run before reporting.

evals.prompt: just give me an analysis of skills/image-artifact-setup, don't change anything yet
evals.expected_output: Uses Review only mode: reads the skill, runs validate.mjs, and reports findings ranked by impact with time estimates. Edits no files.
